column1: # MagiTranslator everyday phrase book (jane PhraseBook). Not in the APK: published to the
# release "jane-dictionaries" and downloaded / imported by the app (DictionaryStore). Keep the first line.
# Format: japanese<TAB>nepali[<TAB>ja>ne], one phrase per line; lines starting with # are comments.
# "ja>ne" in a third column = use only for Japanese -> Nepali (the Nepali is ambiguous when read back).
# A phrase is used only when the WHOLE utterance (or a whole sentence) is the phrase; punctuation and
# spaces are ignored, so "ありがとうございます。" and "ありがとうございます" match the same line.
# Several Japanese lines may share one Nepali translation; for Nepali -> Japanese the FIRST line wins,
# so put the most neutral Japanese first.
# Nepali uses the polite register (तपाईं, -नुहोस्), which is safe with strangers and elders.
# Phrases without a natural equivalent (いただきます, お疲れ様です, よろしくお願いします) are not listed.
# A native speaker should confirm new phrases before they are added.
ありがとうございます
どうもありがとうございます
本当にありがとうございます
# ---- asking for help in a conversation
もう一度お願いします
もう一度言ってください
ゆっくり話してください
ちょっと待ってください
ネパール語が少し話せます
おめでとうございます
誕生日おめでとうございます
